remixhorizons.video.enabled.tip: Retain and render observed terrain beyond the normal view distance.
remixhorizons.video.distance.tip: Maximum radius of cached terrain. Unvisited terrain is never generated.
remixhorizons.video.pixels.tip: Smaller values retain finer detail. Uses actual screen size and field of view.
remixhorizons.video.memory.tip: Memory budget for far terrain mesh data. Ray tracing structures require additional GPU memory.
